map.有效水高 = 缸高 − 底砂厚；长方体 V = 长×宽×水高，圆柱 V = π×: Effective water height = tank height − substrate thickness; for a rectangular tank V = length × width × water height, for a cylinder V = π × (diameter/2)² × water height, and a bow front approximates a trapezoid V = (front length + back length)/2 × width × water height (in cm³). Liters = cm³ ÷ 1000; actual water volume = full volume × 0.9 (allowing for decoration and freeboard). US gallons = liters×0.264172, imperial = liters×0.219969. Filter flow = actual volume×4 (L/h), heating = volume×1.5 W, lighting = volume×0.5 W, water change per time = volume×0.3 L. Density reference (L per fish): neon tetra 2, guppy 3, tiger barb 8, betta 10, goldfish 20, angelfish 30, koi 50, oscar 80.
map.60×30×40 cm 长方缸、底砂 5 cm：水高 35 cm，V = 60×: A 60×30×40 cm rectangular tank with 5 cm of substrate: water height 35 cm, V = 60×30×35 = 63,000 cm³ = 63 L full, actual water volume = 56.7 L. Recommended filtration 227 L/h, heating 85 W, lighting 28 W, 17 L per water change; at 3 L per guppy that is about 18 guppies.
map.为什么实际水量要乘 0.9？: Why is the actual volume multiplied by 0.9?
map.缸内造景石、沉木与水面留边会占用体积，实际可容纳水体少于几何容积；按 0.9 折: Rocks, driftwood and freeboard take up volume inside the tank, so the actual water capacity is below the geometric volume; scaling by 0.9 gives water change volumes and dosing that are closer to reality.
map.过滤流量为什么是水量的 4 倍？: Why is filter flow four times the water volume?
map.每小时循环 3–5 次可维持有效生化过滤与水体流动，4 倍是常用中值；高密度或大: Circulating three to five times per hour maintains effective biological filtration and water movement, and four times is the common midpoint; high densities or large fish need it increased somewhat.
